project.description: Flight project root, relative to this file. Makes this file's directory a standalone simulation project

deployment.description: Deployment directory (the one containing Top/), relative to the flight project

topology.description: Qualified topology name; only needed if Top/ defines more than one

topology_dir.description: Directory of the topology, relative to the deployment, when it is not Top/ (default: Top/, else the one directory the deployment's CMakeLists.txt adds that defines a topology)

output.description: Output directory. Default: wsts/<deployment> in the simulation project, else in the flight project

keep.description: Instances never substituted, e.g. the ground link (comDriver)

gpio_endpoints.description: GPIO endpoints that exist without a surrogate: a model or setup code drives them through the bus, and a gpio link of a system may end at one (e.g. a pulse a register model raises)

instance.description: An instance name; qualified names (SensorLink.uart) always work

endpoint.description: Bus endpoint name (default: the instance's base name); 'none' if the surrogate does not use the bus

register_endpoint.description: The surrogate serves registers through ports of its own shape (a driver that returns a conversion, not a register value): its endpoint takes a register block (kind: register)

bytestream_endpoint.description: The surrogate serves a byte stream through ports of its own shape (a polled UART with a poll port and a send port): a link of a system may end at it

gpio_endpoint.description: The surrogate serves a GPIO pin through ports of its own shape (a pulse-capture driver with no gpioWrite and gpioRead): a gpio link of a system may end at it

ports.description: Flight port name -> surrogate port name; an empty value drops the connection

queue_size.description: For a queued or active surrogate replacing an instance without a queue

substitute.description: Explicit choices of surrogate; override the catalog

endpoint.description: The bus endpoint it answers on

address.description: I2C address (i2c), or SpaceWire logical address, 32 to 255 (packet); or 'any': the device for every address no other device on the endpoint has

params.description: Each becomes model.set(key, value) at start-up. The registers of Wsts::RegisterMapI2c and Wsts::RegisterFile, and the memory of Wsts::RmapTarget (mem.<address>), also take a signal of simulated time, e.g. "sine(offset=1400, amplitude=50, period=20) as u16be"

telemetry.description: A channel per register of a stock register model (Wsts::RegisterMapI2c, Wsts::RegisterFile), with its current value (default true)

topologies.description: Subtopologies to add whole, by qualified name

instances.description: Single instances to add, by qualified name

headers.description: Headers the phase code of those instances needs

connections.description: '<source> -> <target>' between added instances and flight ones

simulators.description: F Prime instances the simulation adds

instance.description: An instance of a Wsts device adapter: Wsts.BusByteStreamDevice, Wsts.BusI2cDevice, Wsts.BusSpiDevice or Wsts.BusGpioDevice

options.description: Passed to wstsServe(): 'chunk=<bytes>' on a byte stream endpoint, 'addr=<n>' (required) on an I2C endpoint

devices.description: Adapter instances that are the device on a bus endpoint

instance.description: An instance of Wsts.SimCycle added by simulators

hz.description: Cycles per second of simulated time, 0.001 to 100000

clocks.description: Rates of the simulation's own cycle sources

base_id.description: Default: first 0x1000 block above all flight IDs

control.description: The wstsControl instance, or 'none' to leave it out

tick_hz.description: Only used when no tick source was substituted

catalogs.description: Project surrogate catalogs, searched before the built-in one

generate.description: Write a Linux main() for a deployment that has none

declarations.description: C++ declarations of the entry points

start.description: C++ expression that starts the deployment; hostname and port come from -a and -p

setup.description: C++ run by the generated set-up, after models are attached and before the runtime starts

extra_subdirectories.description: Modules with no FPP model that components depend on

exclude_subdirectories.description: Modules to leave out, wherever they are added

build_on_host.description: Modules that restrict_platforms() keeps off a Linux host, built anyway (directories relative to the flight project)

depends.description: Extra link dependencies of the topology module

cache.description: CMake cache variables, set before F Prime reads the libraries; a list becomes a CMake list

include.description: CMake files included after all modules, before the deployment

include_early.description: CMake files included before the framework and libraries are read

stub_variants.description: Module directories read with BUILD_TESTING set: their stub variant

cxx_flags.description: Flags of the host C++ compiler: a list for every module, or {<module directory>: [flags]}

bits.description: Width of the simulated deployment's executable: 32 (x86 -m32) or 64; default 64

cmake.description: What the simulated build needs beyond the model

keep.description: Flight libraries to build although nothing in the model uses them

sim.description: Further libraries of the simulation, relative to the simulation project

env.description: Environment of the simulated deployment; a value starting ./ or ../ is a path relative to this file

models.description: Python files with device models, relative to this file. Each defines serve(sim); fprime-wsts run starts them with the deployment and attaches them through the bridge

gds_args.description: Arguments added to the fprime-gds command line when fprime-wsts run starts a GDS, for example [--framing-selection, fprime] for a deployment that does not use the GDS's default framing

fpp_exclude.description: FPP files to leave out of the analysis (glob patterns)

defines.description: Compile definitions, in addition to WSTS_SIM=1

ignore.description: Names the host check does not report: a header, -l<library>, a package, an SDK entry

time.description: How simulated time advances unless a run says otherwise (fprime-wsts run --stepped / --realtime)

mode.description: realtime (default): ticks follow the wall clock. stepped: a tick is taken when flight software has finished the last one, as fast as the host computes

epoch.description: Where simulated time starts in stepped time: seconds since 1970, or a date and time such as 2030-01-01T00:00:00Z (default 2000-01-01T00:00:00Z)

journal.description: Runs keep a journal (fprime-wsts run --journal), so that they can be snapshotted and restored. Needs mode: stepped (default false)

shims.description: Operating system APIs implemented for project code that calls them. vxworks: a POSIX-backed subset of taskLib, semLib, msgQLib, wdLib, sysLib, tickLib, intLib, logLib, errnoLib and ioLib (docs/vxworks-shim.md)

ids.description: The IDs that reach this deployment, as flight software routes commands (an F Prime Svc.CmdSplitter sends the opcodes from one ID up to another computer): [first, last]. Simulator instances outside it are an error, and the WSTS instances go inside. A system's 'ids' for the element wins

sandbox.description: Where the files of flight software land on the host: target paths (/ram0, /tffs0) and relative names are mapped into it. A relative path is relative to the generated directory (where wsts-report.json is), not to this file; an absolute one is used as it is. Default: the files directory of the run (WSTS_DIR)

files.description: The sandbox of the files of flight software

oneOf.description: true or false for every group

models.description: A channel per register of a stock register model (wstsModelTlm); default true

bus.description: The traffic of each bus endpoint (wstsTlm.<endpoint>_*); default true

timing.description: SimSeconds, BusyTicks, LateTicks, Speed (wstsTlm); default true

links.description: Each link to another element of a system (wstsTlm.<link>_*); default true

telemetry.description: The telemetry the generator writes for the deployment, by group. Published with wstsControl's: needs control

dynamics.description: Plants: dynamics simulators stepped between instants in stepped time (docs/dynamics.md). Their outputs are bridge actions, journaled like a client's

name.description: The plant's name: its trace is wsts-logs/dynamics-<name>.jsonl, and its actions carry "via": <name>

python.description: A Python file, relative to the manifest, that defines create(params): an object with step(t, dt, inputs) -> outputs

fmu.description: An FMI 2.0 or 3.0 co-simulation FMU, relative to the manifest

params.description: Given to create(params), or set on the FMU's parameters by name before initialisation

step.description: Seconds of simulated time per exchange; default: every instant

gpio.description: A GPIO endpoint: the level flight software last wrote (1 or 0)

model.description: A model of the manifest: its value 'key' (model_get)

key.description: The model's key (text of a ScriptedByteStream, reg.<offset> of a RegisterFile, a register of a RegisterMapI2c, ...)

register.description: A register endpoint: the register at 'offset', read without a flight read

inputs.description: The plant's inputs by name: where each is read, after an instant

gpio.description: A GPIO endpoint: driven as an input of flight software (an edge when the level changes)

model.description: A model of the manifest: model_set of 'key'

key.description: The model's key (text of a ScriptedByteStream, reg.<offset> of a RegisterFile, a register of a RegisterMapI2c, ...)

register.description: A register endpoint: reg_set of the register at 'offset'

i2c.description: An I2C endpoint: i2c_reg_set of register 'reg' of the register-addressed model at 'addr'

bytes.description: A byte stream endpoint: the 'format'ted text injected when it changes

round.description: To the nearest whole number (implied for registers)

format.description: Python format string of the value, e.g. "$TEMP,{:.1f}\n"

above.description: A threshold: true while the value is above it

below.description: A threshold: true while the value is below it

hysteresis.description: How far back past the threshold the value must go to change again

outputs.description: The plant's outputs by name: where each is written (one place, or a list), before the next instant, when it changes
